description: Evaluation dataset (generation 2+) for AskWRI Cite mode- cross-lingual corpus (en/zh/es/pt). Buildign queries based on literature-discovery style queries ('What's already there on X?') and existence-check queries. Unlike evalset_cite_02.json's fact-lookup queries, these use a broader 'topically substantive' relevance standard.

test_cases.question: What has WRI published on zero-emission heavy-duty truck adoption in China?
test_cases.note: Variation on the q1-q4 review session (evalset_cite_02.json), reframed as a literature-discovery query. expected_* built via qmd vsearch + human review using a 'topically substantive' relevance standard (broader than answer-bearing). Includes two twin-language pairs confirmed by retrieval score parity, previously only 'less probable' hypotheses in issuelog_20260807.md: (1) 2022_china-road-transport-decarbonization_00145 (zh) / 2022_decarbonizing-chinas-road-transport-sector_2101 (en); (2) 2024_techno-economic-feasibility-analysis-of-zero_7051 (en) / 2024_zero-emission-trucks-guangdong_00006 (zh). A follow-up review of candidates scoring 0.50-0.67 (below the initial cutoff) added 3 more: 2021_zero-emission-logistic-vehicles-promotion_1319 and 2024_feasibility-of-zero-emission-freight-zones_1267 (directly on-topic, just scored lower), and 2023_visioning-to-implementation-national-transport_8631 (covers China/India/Vietnam, but contains a substantive China-specific HDV/BEV truck passage in its executive summary, verified via full-text read). Reviewed but excluded from this sweep: a WRI India Fi-ZET tool (India-specific, not China), and several topically-adjacent-but-not-central docs (Hong Kong roads, China provincial transport carbon accounting, container port decarbonization). No Answer-mode counterpart planned for this query (per query_expansion_plan_citemode_20260812.md).
